protocolsAtBoundaries.notes: Retains the boundary review at abec8a0, including its four resolved protocol findings. This delta was reviewed independently at engine, save, and parser seams. Quickstart tracks only exact fresh references, rolls them back in reverse order, never claims foreign container contents, and requires native invalidation plus absent physical custody instead of trusting destruction returns. Contents are rechecked after destruction callbacks; late inserted contents retain the fence without claiming restoration. Installed engine inspection confirmed Obliterate/Graveyard/Validate semantics. Unproved factory or cleanup custody retains a durable quarantine; presence is checked across all five state dictionaries and removal preserves the key. Verified grants commit before separate receipt publication, preserving PublishExisting recovery. Review found vanilla NPC RandomLoot could trigger a false quarantine; NoLoot is now set before creation events, with regression coverage. Raid death/contact guards reject foreign-zone witnesses before count, debit, or lifecycle mutation. Polity validation reconstructs canonical aggregate text without changing the writer, hash derivation, or wire schema; rehashed malformed records reject without mutation. Claude separately identified the raid death defect; its broader permanent-spawn-leak claim was not substantiated by engine inspection and is not claimed fixed. Automated source/behavioral tests do not sign native callbacks, save/load, or play.
